# Nimbus

> Nimbus (Nimbus Advertising Solutions Inc) powers in-app monetization with programmatic's most competitive auction, direct deal support, and truly transparent reporting. Publishers connect once to unlock 60+ demand sources, direct deal activation, and full-transparency reporting; demand partners get the closest supply path possible to some of the world's most sought-after publishers via a 100% first-price, 100% transparent, 100% direct-to-publisher auction.

Nimbus serves two audiences: app publishers (monetization via Nimbus Mediation, Nimbus+ Marketplace, Deal Activation, and Performance Insights) and demand-side partners (DSPs, exchanges, and buyers integrating with the Nimbus RTB exchange). Average publisher revenue increase: 31% with Nimbus+, 24% with Nimbus Core. Tumblr increased revenue 42% after migrating to Nimbus full-stack mediation.

A full agent-readable version of the site is available at /agents.md.

## Pages

- [Home — Unified App Monetization & Programmatic Auction](https://www.adsbynimbus.com/): Full product overview — Nimbus Mediation, Nimbus+ Marketplace, Deal Activation System, Performance Insights, White Glove Service
- [Request a Demo](https://www.adsbynimbus.com/request-a-demo): For app publishers — demo request form
- [Become a Demand Partner](https://www.adsbynimbus.com/request-an-integration): For DSPs, exchanges, and buyers — integration request form
- [Tumblr Case Study](https://www.adsbynimbus.com/tumblr-case-study): 42% combined revenue lift, 87% rCPM lift after migrating to Nimbus full-stack mediation
- [Security & Compliance](https://www.adsbynimbus.com/security-compliance): AICPA SOC-1 Type II certified; GDPR processor with DPA; CCPA-ready; IAB TCF member
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.adsbynimbus.com/privacy-policy)

## Other resources

- [Publisher dashboard sign-in](https://dashboard.adsbynimbus.com/)
- [Careers](https://jobs.lever.co/nimbus/)

<!-- Nimbus Blog embeds stylesheet -->
<style>
/**
 * Nimbus Blog — Webflow embed stylesheet
 * =======================================
 * Upload this ONCE to Webflow (Site Settings → Custom Code → Head, wrapped in
 * a style tag, OR as a hosted stylesheet). Every blog component embed
 * pasted into a Rich Text "Custom Code" block references these namespaced
 * `.blog-*` classes, so the markup you paste stays tiny and updates globally
 * from here.
 *
 * All rules are namespaced under `.blog-embed` / `.blog-*` so they cannot leak
 * into the marketing site's styles.
 *
 * Tokens mirror src/styles/theme.css — teal #08c6c7, pink #dc438c/#da6ea3,
 * navy #003a5b, ink #181d27.
 */

.blog-embed {
    font-family: "Proximanova", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
    color: #181d27;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}
.blog-embed *,
.blog-embed *::before,
.blog-embed *::after {
    box-sizing: border-box;
}
/* Neutralize Webflow's default `.w-richtext figure { max-width: 60% }` so embed
   components built on <figure> (e.g. Insight Callout) fill the content width. */
.blog-embed figure { max-width: 100%; }

/* =====================================================================
   Metrics Row  —  .blog-metrics
===================================================================== */
.blog-metrics {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    gap: 20px;
    margin: 0;
}
@media (min-width: 900px) {
    .blog-metrics[data-cols="3"] { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
    .blog-metrics[data-cols="4"] { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); }
}
@media (max-width: 520px) {
    .blog-metrics { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}
.blog-metric {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 12px;
    background: #ffffff;
    border: 1px solid #e9eaeb;
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 24px;
    box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(16, 24, 40, 0.05);
}
.blog-metric__label { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.4; color: #717680; }
.blog-metric__value {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin: auto 0 0;
    font-size: 30px; line-height: 1.2; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    color: #181d27; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.blog-metric__arrow { font-weight: 800; line-height: 1; }
.blog-metric__arrow--up { color: #08c6c7; }
.blog-metric__arrow--down { color: #da6ea3; }

/* =====================================================================
   Pull Quote  —  .blog-quote  (variants: teal / pink / navy)
===================================================================== */
.blog-quote { margin: 0; border-left: 4px solid #08c6c7; padding-left: 24px; }
.blog-quote--teal { border-color: #08c6c7; }
.blog-quote--pink { border-color: #da6ea3; }
.blog-quote--navy { border-color: #003a5b; }
.blog-quote__text { margin: 0; font-size: 26px; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 400; color: #181d27; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
.blog-quote__by { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-top: 16px; }
.blog-quote__avatar {
    flex: none; width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 50%;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; color: #fff;
    background-size: cover; background-position: center;
}
.blog-quote__avatar--teal { background-color: #08c6c7; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px #08c6c7; }
.blog-quote__avatar--pink { background-color: #da6ea3; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px #da6ea3; }
.blog-quote__avatar--navy { background-color: #003a5b; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px #003a5b; }
/* Photo avatars (inline background-image): framed look matching the React component —
   photo → thin white gap → colored ring (base box-shadow). Drop the colored fill so no
   colored sliver shows at the photo edge. Initials keep the base fill for the circle. */
.blog-quote__avatar[style] { background-color: transparent; }
.blog-quote__name { display: block; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: #181d27; }
.blog-quote__role { display: block; font-size: 15px; color: #535862; }

/* =====================================================================
   Insight Callout  —  .blog-insight  (variants: teal / pink / navy)
===================================================================== */
.blog-insight {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px;
    border-left: 4px solid #4a9ea0; padding: 24px; margin: 0;
}
@media (min-width: 768px) { .blog-insight { gap: 28px; padding: 28px 32px; } }
.blog-insight__icon { flex: none; width: 36px; height: 36px; object-fit: contain; }
@media (min-width: 768px) { .blog-insight__icon { width: 40px; height: 40px; } }
.blog-insight__text { margin: 0; font-size: 19px; line-height: 1.45; font-weight: 400; }
@media (min-width: 768px) { .blog-insight__text { font-size: 21px; } }
.blog-insight--teal { border-color: #4a9ea0; background: #e9f7f6; }
.blog-insight--teal .blog-insight__text { color: #4a9ea0; }
.blog-insight--pink { border-color: #d98cb5; background: #fdf0f6; }
.blog-insight--pink .blog-insight__text { color: #bf4f8a; }
.blog-insight--navy { border-color: #6a93ad; background: #eef4f8; }
.blog-insight--navy .blog-insight__text { color: #3f6d8c; }

/* =====================================================================
   Key Takeaway  —  .blog-takeaway
===================================================================== */
.blog-takeaway {
    border-top: 3px solid #4a9ea0; background: #f1fbfa;
    padding: 40px 24px; margin: 0; text-align: center;
}
@media (min-width: 768px) { .blog-takeaway { padding: 56px 32px; margin: 0; } }
.blog-takeaway__eyebrow { margin: 0; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #3f9a9c; }
.blog-takeaway__text { margin: 16px auto 0; max-width: 42rem; font-size: 22px; line-height: 1.45; font-weight: 400; color: #1f2d33; }
@media (min-width: 768px) { .blog-takeaway__text { font-size: 26px; } }
.blog-takeaway--teal { border-color: #4a9ea0; background: #f1fbfa; }
.blog-takeaway--teal .blog-takeaway__eyebrow { color: #3f9a9c; }
.blog-takeaway--pink { border-color: #d98cb5; background: #fdf0f6; }
.blog-takeaway--pink .blog-takeaway__eyebrow { color: #bf4f8a; }
.blog-takeaway--navy { border-color: #6a93ad; background: #eef4f8; }
.blog-takeaway--navy .blog-takeaway__eyebrow { color: #3f6d8c; }

/* =====================================================================
   Stat Callout  —  .blog-stat  (variants: teal / pink / navy; layout: left)
===================================================================== */
.blog-stat {
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px;
    border-radius: 16px; padding: 40px 24px; margin: 0;
    align-items: center; text-align: center;
}
.blog-stat--left { align-items: flex-start; text-align: left; }
.blog-stat__value { font-size: 64px; line-height: 1; font-weight: 800; }
.blog-stat__label { max-width: 28rem; font-size: 18px; color: #535862; }
.blog-stat--teal { background: #f1fcfb; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #cef4f4; }
.blog-stat--teal .blog-stat__value { color: #08c6c7; }
.blog-stat--pink { background: #fdf2f7; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #f6d4e6; }
.blog-stat--pink .blog-stat__value { color: #da6ea3; }
.blog-stat--navy { background: #eef3f7; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #d1e0ea; }
.blog-stat--navy .blog-stat__value { color: #003a5b; }

/* =====================================================================
   Checklist  —  .blog-checklist
===================================================================== */
.blog-checklist { margin: 0; }
.blog-checklist__heading { margin: 0 0 16px; font-size: 21px; font-weight: 800; color: #181d27; }
.blog-checklist__list { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; }
.blog-checklist__item { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 16px; font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.35; color: #181d27; }
.blog-checklist__icon { flex: none; width: 20px; height: 20px; margin-top: 2px; color: #23a6a9; }

/* =====================================================================
   Numbered Steps  —  .blog-steps
===================================================================== */
.blog-steps { margin: 0; }
.blog-steps__heading { margin: 0; font-size: 30px; line-height: 1.2; font-weight: 800; color: #181d27; }
@media (min-width: 768px) { .blog-steps__heading { font-size: 36px; } }
.blog-steps__desc { margin: 12px 0 0; font-size: 18px; line-height: 28px; color: #535862; }
.blog-steps__list { margin-top: 24px; }
.blog-step { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; gap: 20px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); padding: 32px 0; }
@media (min-width: 768px) { .blog-step { gap: 40px; padding: 40px 0; } }
.blog-step__num { font-size: 44px; line-height: 1; font-weight: 800; }
@media (min-width: 768px) { .blog-step__num { font-size: 64px; } }
.blog-step__title { margin: 0; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; color: #181d27; }
@media (min-width: 768px) { .blog-step__title { font-size: 24px; } }
.blog-step__items { margin: 16px 0 0; padding-left: 20px; list-style: circle; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; font-size: 18px; line-height: 26px; color: #535862; }
.blog-step__items li::marker { color: #98a2b3; }
/* Flat variant: no bullets, flush to the title. */
.blog-step__items--flat { padding-left: 0; list-style: none; }

/* =====================================================================
   Logo Statement  —  .blog-logo-statement
===================================================================== */
.blog-logo-statement { margin: 0; padding: 40px 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); }
@media (min-width: 768px) { .blog-logo-statement { padding: 56px 0; } }
.blog-logo-statement__grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 24px; }
@media (min-width: 768px) { .blog-logo-statement__grid { grid-template-columns: 200px 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 48px; } }
/* Fixed box + object-fit:contain SCALES each logo to fill the box (up or down),
   preserving aspect ratio and left-aligning it in the logo column. Using a fixed
   width+height (rather than max-*, which can only shrink) means small-intrinsic
   SVGs enlarge to a consistent size instead of rendering tiny. */
.blog-logo-statement__logo { width: 150px; height: 44px; object-fit: contain; object-position: left center; }
@media (min-width: 768px) { .blog-logo-statement__logo { width: 160px; height: 48px; } }
/* Square / stacked logos (aspect ratio ~1:1–2.5:1, e.g. an icon over a wordmark)
   get a taller, wider box so they fill the column and carry the same visual weight
   as a wide wordmark. */
.blog-logo-statement__logo--square { width: 150px; height: 76px; }
@media (min-width: 768px) { .blog-logo-statement__logo--square { width: 190px; height: 96px; } }
.blog-logo-statement__text { margin: 0; font-size: 18px; line-height: 28px; color: #535862; }
@media (min-width: 768px) { .blog-logo-statement__text { font-size: 20px; line-height: 32px; } }

/* =====================================================================
   Imagery / Figure  —  .blog-figure
===================================================================== */
.blog-figure { margin: 0; }
.blog-figure__img { display: block; width: 100%; border-radius: 16px; object-fit: cover; }
.blog-figure__caption { margin: 12px 0 0; font-size: 15px; font-style: italic; color: #535862; }

/* =====================================================================
   Tag List  —  .blog-tags
===================================================================== */
.blog-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin: 0; }
.blog-tag { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 999px; }
.blog-tag--brand { background: #d0f7f7; color: #0b6e70; }
.blog-tag--pink { background: #fbe4f0; color: #b32a6e; }
.blog-tag--navy { background: #dbeaf3; color: #003a5b; }
.blog-tag--gray { background: #f0eee9; color: #5b5347; }
.blog-tag--success { background: #dcfae6; color: #079455; }
.blog-tag--indigo { background: #e0eaff; color: #3538cd; }
.blog-tag--sky { background: #e0f2fe; color: #026aa2; }

/* =====================================================================
   Metrics Table  —  .blog-table
===================================================================== */
.blog-table { margin: 0; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e9eaeb; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(16, 24, 40, 0.05); }
.blog-table__head { padding: 20px 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e9eaeb; }
.blog-table__title { margin: 0; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; color: #181d27; }
.blog-table__desc { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 15px; color: #717680; }
.blog-table__scroll { overflow-x: auto; }
.blog-table table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; }
.blog-table th { text-align: left; padding: 12px 24px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #717680; background: #fcfcfd; border-bottom: 1px solid #e9eaeb; white-space: nowrap; }
.blog-table td { padding: 16px 24px; font-size: 16px; color: #535862; border-bottom: 1px solid #f0f0f2; white-space: nowrap; }
.blog-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }
.blog-table__geo { font-weight: 400; color: #181d27; }
.blog-table__lift { display: inline-block; padding: 3px 12px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; background: #dcfae6; color: #079455; }
.blog-table__lift--down { background: #fee4e2; color: #d92d20; }
.blog-table__lift--gray { background: #f0eee9; color: #5b5347; }
.blog-table__lift--brand { background: #d0f7f7; color: #0b6e70; }
.blog-table__lift--navy { background: #dbeaf3; color: #003a5b; }
.blog-table__bold { font-weight: 600; color: #181d27; }
.blog-table__muted { color: #a4a7ae; }
.blog-table__icon { width: 20px; height: 20px; vertical-align: middle; }
.blog-table__icon--check { color: #079455; }
.blog-table__icon--cross { color: #d92d20; }

/* =====================================================================
   FAQ  —  .blog-faq  (native <details>, no JS)
===================================================================== */
.blog-faq { margin: 0; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e9eaeb; border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(16, 24, 40, 0.05); }
@media (min-width: 768px) { .blog-faq { padding: 32px; } }
.blog-faq__eyebrow { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #0b6e70; }
.blog-faq__heading { margin: 12px 0 0; font-size: 30px; line-height: 1.2; font-weight: 600; color: #181d27; }
@media (min-width: 768px) { .blog-faq__heading { font-size: 36px; } }
.blog-faq__desc { margin: 16px 0 24px; font-size: 18px; color: #717680; }
.blog-faq__list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.blog-faq__item { border-radius: 16px; padding: 20px; transition: background 0.2s ease; }
@media (min-width: 768px) { .blog-faq__item { padding: 24px; } }
.blog-faq__item[open] { background: #f1fcfb; }
.blog-faq__q { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 16px; cursor: pointer; list-style: none; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: #181d27; }
.blog-faq__q::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
.blog-faq__icon { flex: none; width: 24px; height: 24px; color: #08c6c7; }
.blog-faq__icon-v { transform-origin: center; transition: transform 0.15s ease-out; }
.blog-faq__item[open] .blog-faq__icon-v { transform: rotate(-90deg); }
.blog-faq__a { margin: 8px 0 0; padding-right: 32px; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.6; color: #535862; }

/* =====================================================================
   Charts  —  .blog-chart-card / .blog-chart  (rendered by the charts runtime)
===================================================================== */
.blog-chart-card {
    margin: 0;
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px solid #e9eaeb;
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 24px;
    box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(16, 24, 40, 0.05);
}
.blog-chart-card__head { margin-bottom: 16px; }
.blog-chart-card__title { margin: 0; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: #181d27; }
.blog-chart-card__desc { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 14px; color: #717680; }
.blog-chart { position: relative; height: 300px; }
.blog-chart canvas { max-width: 100%; }

/* =====================================================================
   Performance Panels  —  .blog-perf  (static bars)
===================================================================== */
.blog-perf { margin: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 24px; }

Tumblr is one of the internet's most recognizable platforms for creators, fandoms, and culture-driven communities. With highly engaged audiences across its mobile apps on iOS and Android, Tumblr's monetization strategy needs to support both scale and user experience while unlocking more demand without operational complexity.

Tumblr was previously leveraging Nimbus as a layered auction within an existing mediation stack. While this approach introduced incremental demand, it inherently limited: auction transparency and control, holistic demand competition, operational efficiency across partners, and full access to the Nimbus demand ecosystem.

Like many scaled publishers, Tumblr faced a structural constraint: layered integrations optimize around existing systems, they don't redefine the auction itself.

Tumblr migrated to Nimbus as its full-stack mediation platform, replacing the layered architecture with a unified auction environment.
